dimension_scale.1: major failure; plausible-looking output masks broken reasoning
dimension_scale.2: material gaps; usable only with substantial redesign
dimension_scale.3: competent; important tradeoffs handled but craft/coverage is ordinary
dimension_scale.4: strong; coherent, deliberate, resilient, with minor gaps
dimension_scale.5: exceptional for the task; decisions are specific, integrated, evidenced, and hard to improve without a real tradeoff

scoring.rule: hard gates are evaluated before quality dimensions; any failed applicable hard gate blocks release regardless of average score

authority-preservation.pass: explicit user/product/accepted-target constraints are preserved or conflicts are surfaced and resolved by authority
authority-preservation.fail: agent silently changes a material requirement, fidelity target, product truth, or preservation boundary

no-self-certification.pass: material completion is supported by independent critic/evidence or clearly remains unverified
no-self-certification.fail: generator's confidence, compile success, or self-review is the sole release proof

unknown-not-pass.pass: missing capability/evidence remains UNKNOWN/BLOCKED and claim is narrowed
unknown-not-pass.fail: agent assumes an unexecuted browser/a11y/mobile/fidelity check passed

state-coverage.pass: material interaction/async/error/permission/content/environment states are explicitly accounted for
state-coverage.fail: known consequential states are missing or replaced by a default screenshot

accessibility-scope.pass: accessibility claims are scoped to actual normative/tool/manual evidence
accessibility-scope.fail: tool score or visual inspection is expanded into unsupported compliance/accessibility claims

fidelity-evidence.pass: strict fidelity claims compare authoritative target with inspectable current render for the claimed states/viewports
fidelity-evidence.fail: code inspection, memory, or a different/stale screenshot substitutes for comparison

high-ambition-aesthetic-evidence.pass: flagship/exceptional/experiential completion includes preserved experiential intent, divergence/reference evidence, legibility, attractor audit, signature depth, visual energy, adequacy and no outstanding RE_DIVERGE decision
high-ambition-aesthetic-evidence.fail: compile/render health or contract fidelity is used as the sole proof that an exceptional visual objective was achieved

quality_dimensions.product-fit: hierarchy and behavior derive from actual product objects, user jobs, trust/risk, frequency, and consequences
quality_dimensions.information-architecture: grouping, labels, hierarchy, navigation, and comparison relationships form a learnable/scalable model
quality_dimensions.interaction-quality: affordance, modality, state, feedback, async behavior, destructive recovery, and focus behavior are coherent
quality_dimensions.visual-hierarchy: attention order, composition, typography, color, spacing, surfaces, and media reinforce task/product priority
quality_dimensions.aesthetic-specificity: visual thesis is rooted in subject/brand/context rather than interchangeable category defaults; novelty is budgeted
quality_dimensions.system-coherence: tokens/components/variants/states are semantically reusable without one-off drift or forced abstraction
quality_dimensions.responsive-durability: task priority and access survive viewport/container/content/input pressure with intentional transformations
quality_dimensions.inclusive-design: semantics, keyboard/focus, contrast/reflow, motion, target, error, locale/RTL, and AT considerations are integrated as applicable
quality_dimensions.content-quality: labels, actions, status, errors, empty states, and terminology help users predict and recover without generic marketing filler
quality_dimensions.aesthetic-excellence: for the stated ambition, the selected direction has sufficient aesthetic fit, emotional force, memorability, material richness, refinement, signature strength and perceptual harmony rather than merely being specific

aesthetic_excellence_vector.aesthetic_fit: fit to the preserved experiential intent
aesthetic_excellence_vector.emotional_force: strength of intended affect without harming task/safety
aesthetic_excellence_vector.memorability: presence of a defensible memorable mechanism or deliberately distinctive quietness
aesthetic_excellence_vector.material_richness: perceptual richness appropriate to the thesis across surface, media, type, light/color and depth
aesthetic_excellence_vector.visual_refinement: optical craft, hierarchy, rhythm and resolved detail
aesthetic_excellence_vector.signature_strength: depth and indispensability of product-specific signature mechanisms
aesthetic_excellence_vector.perceptual_harmony: coherence of contrast, rhythm, scale, energy and quiet
aesthetic_excellence_vector.role_identity: fit to truthful aspirational identity when applicable
